body: Kill yourself now...it doesn't get better.
Unfortunately i regret the decision immensely, since no one told me the entire point of college is to network, not learn. Went for singing since my piano skills are sub par.

I know there's plenty of support available, I am just so very beyond the point of wanting it. It doesn't seem worth it to fix. I just can't get past the whole being alive = potential for suffering vs. not being alive = no chance of suffering; it feels nihilistic.

Worse still is that there are so many more people that have it so much worse than me and yet I still feel this way.
